# Surface appearance

SurfaceAppearance lets you apply PBR textures to a MeshPart.
Set AlphaMode to Transparency to render semi-transparent foliage cards; Overlay blends the ColorMap over the part color.
The maximum texture resolution is 1024x1024 for ColorMap, NormalMap, RoughnessMap and MetalnessMap.
Foliage cards that use Transparency mode may sort incorrectly when many transparent surfaces overlap.
